paper_metadata.title: Effects of Vanadium Addition on the Material Properties of L12-Type Ordered Alloys in the Al-Ti-Cr System
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of the Japan Institute of Metals

evidence.quote: To investigate the effects of vanadium addition on the formation and material properties of the L12-type intermetallic compounds in the Al-Ti-Cr system
The L12-type alloys in the Al-Ti-(Cr+V) system have a smaller linear expansion coefficient and an excellent oxidation resistance as well as the L12 Al-Ti-Cr alloys without vanadium.
